history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

They are holding a smartphone with a black case adorned with white stickers, one of which appears to be a stylized heart. The phone is angled to capture the reflection. Visible on the subject's hands are rings, including one on their ring finger. White earbuds are connected to the phone and hang loosely. The background is a plain wall with what appears to be a door or closet on the right side. The lighting is soft and ambient, creating a slightly moody atmosphere. The color palette is muted, with dominant tones of black, grey, and white, tinged with a slight blue and green cast from the image's low quality and potential digital artifacts. The overall mood is casual and introspective, with a hint of vintage or lo-fi aesthetic due to the image quality. The left side of the image shows a more pixelated and distorted reflection of the subject and their phone, adding to the glitchy, retro feel.
